mapper.select: SELECT CHOICE AS CHOICE, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM MISSION_MODE_VOTE_BALLOT WHERE VOTE_ID = #{voteId} GROUP BY CHOICE ORDER BY CHOICE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO MISSION_MODE_VOTE_BALLOT t USING (SELECT #{voteId} AS VOTE_ID, #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{choice} AS CHOICE FROM DUAL) s ON (t.VOTE_ID = s.VOTE_ID AND t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CHOICE = s.CHOICE, t.VOTED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (VOTE_ID, MEMBER_ID, CHOICE) VALUES (s.VOTE_ID, s.MEMBER_ID, s.CHOICE)
